package: Sonic Companion So What Audio Lab Engine
scope: Miles Davis — So What, original 1959 Kind of Blue studio recording only
generation_source: Direct input_audio to GPT-Audio 1.5; no prewritten event content or DSP-generated musical moments

chunking.passes_per_excerpt: mandatory primary + mandatory independent detail + adaptive depth

features: matched Audio Lab 2.1 producer and bridge consumer schema
mandatory ensemble detail pass for every window
adaptive depth pass for low-density or low-diversity windows
overlap deduplication that preserves distinct same-pass gestures
model-generated bilingual event explanations and listening-log summaries
performer attribution constrained by session roster and instrument mapping
per-moment progress bars in Audio Lab cards, active cue and full main-app cue list
model guide opens in Full view so card countdowns are visible
visible build ID, bridge version and actual cue count
existing Spotify playback, track progress and countdown retained
direct-audio provenance, exact-track identity/duration and density/continuity guards
release_status: Nine automated Node.js suites pass, including actual bridge plus actual app renderer DOM-harness test (38 moments / 38 bars). Live music analysis, physical iPhone Safari, Spotify session and deployment are not tested.
